scenario.name: r-cd-collection-on-collapse
scenario.description: A→B→C delegate chain where intermediate B is detached/collapsed before C returns; root A still collects C sentinel.
scenario.notes: Scaffold only. Requires reviewed mode=session/detached intermediate design before live fire; do not run concurrently with other continuation rows in the same session.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: construct A→B→C collection-on-collapse chain with detached intermediate only when explicitly live-fired. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: root-dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Root A accepts dispatch that creates detached intermediate B.

expectedReceipts.name: intermediate-session-detached
expectedReceipts.description: Intermediate B is created as a session/detached participant, not a run-mode transient.

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-sentinel
expectedReceipts.description: Grandchild C emits nonce-correlated sentinel after B is collapsed or unavailable.

expectedReceipts.name: root-collection
expectedReceipts.description: Root A receives/collects C sentinel despite intermediate B collapse.

expectedReceipts.name: negative-orphan-guard
expectedReceipts.description: Evidence shows C return is not orphaned or delivered only to collapsed B.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying A→B→C and root collection.

review.notes: Scaffold/registry only until a human-reviewed live-fire design handles the mode=session detached intermediate and collapse trigger. Never fold as pass without root-collection and negative-orphan evidence.
